name: comp-386
blurb: Paginated tour popover with left/right arrow buttons for navigation between steps.
description: Multi-step tour popover with previous/next buttons and step counter. Buttons disable at the first and last steps.
use_when: Guided tours with many steps where users should navigate freely (not just forward).
avoid_when: Linear flows where users should only move forward.
a11y: Navigation buttons have aria-labels and are keyboard-accessible.
